description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham Golden is a roadside motel situated directly on the Trans-Canada Highway in Golden, BC, a hub town for cyclists travelling through the Rocky Mountain Trench between Yoho and Glacier national parks. As part of the Super 8 by Wyndham brand it offers standardised budget accommodation in a location that sees heavy touring-cyclist traffic on the TransCanada corridor. The motel is well-positioned for resupply and rest between the challenging mountain passes on either side of Golden.
